subject.title: Feature/Fix: Validate and optimize lineage token accounting

question: Should CodexBar adopt this stacked lineage ledger as the permanent post-containment accounting architecture while keeping legacy authority as the default?
rationale: The merged partial fix explicitly deferred exact provenance work, but accepting a parallel accounting engine and its future promotion contract is an architectural choice with cache, performance, and historical-total compatibility consequences.

options.title: Adopt behind legacy authority
options.body: Review and land the four PRs in order, keep legacy as the default, and require reviewed evidence before any production authorization is issued.

options.title: Keep diagnostics only
options.body: Accept only frozen replay and aggregate diagnostics while deferring the selector and permanent lineage-authority surface.

options.title: Pause the lineage stack
options.body: Retain the merged bounded containment and collect more independent finalized-day corpora before adopting the new architecture.

recommendation.title: Adopt behind legacy authority
recommendation.body: Review and land the four PRs in order, keep legacy as the default, and require reviewed evidence before any production authorization is issued.

likelyOwner.reason: They merged and refined the current containment path and documented the invariants that the proposed architecture must preserve.
